_comment: Certified KPI definitions and their parameters. build_gold.py loads them into ref.kpi_definition and ref.kpi_parameter; the semantic views read only those tables, so a rate changes here and nowhere else. Rates are demo values, not RBI's full secured/unsecured schedule.

kpis.name: NPA exposure
kpis.definition: Outstanding principal of loans that are non-performing on the reporting date under the RBI IRAC norms: overdue for more than 90 days, or classified as a loss asset. Asset class from the age of the NPA (sub-standard up to 12 months, doubtful 1 / 2 / 3, loss when flagged). Gross NPA ratio = gross NPA / gross advances.
kpis.formula: gross_npa = SUM(principal_outstanding) WHERE dpd > 90 OR loss-flagged; gross_npa_ratio = gross_npa / SUM(principal_outstanding); provision = SUM(principal_outstanding * provision_rate[asset_class])

kpis.name: CASA ratio
kpis.definition: Share of current and savings account balances in total deposits (current + savings + term), from end-of-day ledger balances in INR on the reporting date.
kpis.formula: casa_ratio = SUM(balance_inr WHERE deposit_type IN ('SAVINGS','CURRENT')) / SUM(balance_inr)

kpis.name: Customer relationship value
kpis.definition: Annualised value of a customer's whole relationship with the bank: CASA balances at the CASA spread, term deposits at the TD spread, loans outstanding at the product's lending margin (non-performing loans earn nothing), and fee income of the last 30 days annualised.
kpis.formula: crv = casa_balance * casa_spread + td_balance * td_spread + SUM(performing loan_outstanding * lending_margin[product]) + fees_last_30_days * 12
